description:
Operate the vault's quick-capture buffer queue: capture, regroup, validate, flush into daily logs.

Top-level flag: --quiet suppresses info output.

Subcommands:
  add TEXT — append an UNKNOWN entry; raw quick-capture with no thread, fails `tend` until converted
  suggest TEXT [-y] — propose a structured add-* for raw text; prompts to accept or falls back to UNKNOWN
  add-text THREAD TEXT — append a TEXT entry, a free-text observation
  add-ref THREAD TARGET [SUMMARY] [--date YYYY-MM-DD] — append a REF entry pointing at another vault file
  add-action THREAD TEXT [--due YYYY-MM-DD] [--scheduled YYYY-MM-DD] [--priority H|M|L] [--depends UUID8] — append an ACTION entry; also reachable as `tasks add`
  list [FILTER] — show the buffer with line numbers
  rm LINE_NUMBER — remove a single line by line number
  tend — regroup by thread and date, then validate; idempotent
  flush — tend, then write entries into the daily logs and clear the buffer

Flags:
  add-ref: TARGET is a wikilink target — notes/<stem>, logs/<path>, people/<name>, hours/<Kind>/<Thread>, payments/<Kind>/<Thread>, or <Kind>/<Thread>. --date files the entry under that day instead of today; use the day the thing happened.
  add-action: --due date applied on flush plus ingest; --scheduled date; --priority one of H, M, L; --depends 8-hex-char uuid prefix, repeatable for multiple deps.
  suggest: -y auto-accepts the suggestion without prompting.

Examples:
  ["add-text", "Projects/SGB", "Join semantics on multi-repo commits still unresolved."]
  ["add-action", "Projects/SGB", "(Riaz Arbi) Send quarterly report", "--due", "2026-06-15", "--priority", "H"]
  ["list"]
  ["flush"]

Notes:
  Never call `suggest` without -y — without it, it prompts on stdin.
  Prefer `add-text` / `add-ref` / `add-action` over `add`: UNKNOWN entries are deliberately invalid and block `flush` until removed with `rm` and re-added in structured form.
  THREAD must resolve to an existing thread file; check with `threads list` first.
  `flush` rewrites the buffer file and appends to logs; run `tend` first to see validation problems without writing logs.
  ACTION lines only become TASK anchors after `flush` and a subsequent no-subcommand `tasks` run.
  Do not edit the buffer file directly; `tend` is the way to fix it.
  Exit 1 on empty text or description, a malformed --date or --due, or a --depends that is not 8 hex chars.
